feature_contract.goal: Preserve the intended 4:3 menu and car-select aspect across 4:3, 16:9 and 21:9 source windows and a game process restart that recycles the HWND with a different letterbox configuration.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R23 local-fixed menu letterbox config cache and native aspect planner smoke only. No gameplay HUD, F11, ESC, world stereo, SkyGlow, FFB or other backend.
trace_stages: Game EXE menu producer and UIScalingMode/UILetterboxing settings from the game process config generate the authored 4:3 content.
R23 validates current HWND and PID before choosing cached letterbox policy, then PlanVisibleCenteredContent crops source UV and preserves desktop fallback.
R23 optically centered LOCAL menu projection samples the crop identically in two OpenXR eye slices without touching game-world stereo and HUD.
subcomponents: Bind cache identity to HWND and owning PID, immediately invalidating missing owners and recycled handles before optical crop selection.
Preserve normal 2.5-second same-process INI polling, native desktop and 4:3/16:9/21:9 menu aspect mapping and no-crop fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: When a new process reuses the prior HWND, the new PID immediately invalidates cached menu letterboxing and the current game INI controls the cropped LOCAL menu.
Identical HWND/PID retains bounded INI polling; invalid owner and HWND fail closed, and the preexisting 4:3/16:9/21:9 native aspect, clipping and desktop fallback continue unchanged.
Menu native static assertions and exact-SHA GitHub DX9Ex Active host/game/package, Domain Isolation, and Full Source Impact gates pass.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The original R23GameMenuIsLetterboxed checks only gameWindow==cachedWindow and now<nextCheckMs before reading the HWND-owning PID. Recycled Win32 HWND values can reuse an obsolete menu crop for 2.5 seconds.
source_trace: The game process loads UI letterbox overrides from OutRun2006Tweaks.ini and .user.ini.
Host R23 game HWND cache feeds cropCentered43 before validating current game PID; wrong owner policy enters the source UV cropping plan.
Fixed LOCAL menu clip and per-eye OpenXR projection preserve those chosen coordinates and may show the wrong menu aspect.
diagnosis.root_cause: The menu configuration cache was keyed only by HWND value; PID changes between restarts did not invalidate the cached letterbox result.
alternatives_rejected: Forcing a universal 4:3 crop cuts the unletterboxed original full-width desktop menu.
Removing the 2.5-second INI cache would move game-process filesystem reads onto each XR tick.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Read owning PID before the cache hit; use a constexpr HWND/PID/deadline predicate to invalidate on new process, replaced HWND, invalid owner or time expiry.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Compile-time positive/negative assertions cover same-run cached use, recycled HWND with changed PID, replaced HWND, missing HWND/PID, deadline expiry and first poll.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The existing same-raster LOCAL menu projection is shared across both eye slices; gameplay sprite stereo and protected world/HUD draws are not modified.

runtime_gate: No Quest3/VDXR test performed; menu optical correctness remains RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED.
next_action: Verify exact SHA in DX9Ex Active full host/game/package, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact; fix any failure under the same TASK_ID.
